text: sql = "UPDATE job_items SET state=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_events e WHERE e.item_id=job_items.item_id AND e.event_type='provider-outcome-uncertain' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_events r WHERE r.attempt_id=e.attempt_id AND r.event_type='provider-response')) THEN 'dead_letter' WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM attempts a WHERE a.item_id=job_items.item_id AND a.outcome<>'cancelled')>=" || maximum_attempts || " AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_events e WHERE e.item_id=job_items.item_id AND e.event_type='provider-response') THEN 'dead_letter' ELSE 'queued' END,worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,retry_at=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER),updated_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE state='running' AND lease_until<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)"

i.state='dead_letter' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_replay_items r WHERE r.replay_item_id=i.item_id)),lineage(root_item_id,item_id,depth) AS (SELECT root_item_id,root_item_id,0 FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT l.root_item_id,r.replay_item_id,l.depth+1 FROM lineage l JOIN job_replay_items r ON r.source_item_id=l.item_id WHERE l.depth<64) SELECT roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_tasks t ON t.task_id=m.task_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND t.state='resolved') OR sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'resolved' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_task_items n ON n.task_id=m.task_id JOIN job_items j ON j.item_id=n.item_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND j.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested')) OR sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'in-progress' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_task_waivers v ON v.task_id=m.task_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND v.state='active') THEN 'waived' ELSE 'actionable' END AS reconciliation_state,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replay_count,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state='dead_letter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_descendants,max(items.updated_at) AS last_updated_at FROM roots JOIN lineage ON lineage.root_item_id=roots.root_item_id JOIN job_items items ON items.item_id=lineage.item_id GROUP BY roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type"

statements[statements.0 + 1] = "CREATE VIEW dead_letter_reconciliation AS WITH RECURSIVE roots(root_item_id,root_job_id,item_type) AS (SELECT i.item_id,i.job_id,i.item_type FROM job_items i WHERE i.state='dead_letter' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_replay_items r WHERE r.replay_item_id=i.item_id)),lineage(root_item_id,item_id,depth) AS (SELECT root_item_id,root_item_id,0 FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT l.root_item_id,r.replay_item_id,l.depth+1 FROM lineage l JOIN job_replay_items r ON r.source_item_id=l.item_id WHERE l.depth<64) SELECT roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type,CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'resolved' WHEN sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'in-progress' ELSE 'actionable' END AS reconciliation_state,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replay_count,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state='dead_letter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_descendants,max(items.updated_at) AS last_updated_at FROM roots JOIN lineage ON lineage.root_item_id=roots.root_item_id JOIN job_items items ON items.item_id=lineage.item_id GROUP BY roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type"

sql = "WITH RECURSIVE lineage(generation) AS (SELECT " || current || " UNION ALL SELECT p.parent_generation FROM published_generations p JOIN lineage l ON p.generation=l.generation WHERE p.parent_generation IS NOT NULL) SELECT count(*) FROM lineage JOIN published_generations p USING(generation) WHERE generation=" || target_generation || " AND p.state='published'"

sql = qualifier || "vector_generation_id IN (WITH RECURSIVE target(generation) AS (SELECT " || generation_sql || "), lineage(generation) AS (SELECT generation FROM target UNION ALL SELECT p.parent_generation FROM published_generations p JOIN lineage l ON p.generation=l.generation WHERE p.parent_generation IS NOT NULL), candidates AS (SELECT v.* FROM vector_generations v JOIN lineage l ON l.generation=v.semantic_generation WHERE v.state='published'), latest AS (SELECT a.* FROM candidates a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidates b WHERE b.embedding_profile_id=a.embedding_profile_id AND b.semantic_generation>a.semantic_generation)) SELECT v.vector_generation_id FROM latest v CROSS JOIN target t WHERE v.semantic_generation=t.generation OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revision_chunks rc WHERE (rc.visible_from_generation<=v.semantic_generation AND (rc.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rc.visible_to_generation>v.semantic_generation))<>(rc.visible_from_generation<=t.generation AND (rc.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rc.visible_to_generation>t.generation))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revision_chunk_embeddings rce JOIN embeddings e ON e.embedding_id=rce.embedding_id WHERE e.embedding_profile_id=v.embedding_profile_id AND (rce.visible_from_generation<=v.semantic_generation AND (rce.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rce.visible_to_generation>v.semantic_generation))<>(rce.visible_from_generation<=t.generation AND (rce.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rce.visible_to_generation>t.generation)))))"

sql="WITH RECURSIVE upstream(revision,external,depth) AS (SELECT target_revision_id,external_work_ref,0 FROM source_relations WHERE relation_id IN(SELECT value FROM json_each(" || _q(selected) || ")) AND visible_from_generation<=" || generation || " AND (visible_to_generation IS NULL OR visible_to_generation>" || generation || ") UNION SELECT r.target_revision_id,r.external_work_ref,u.depth+1 FROM upstream u JOIN source_relations r ON r.revision_id=u.revision WHERE u.depth<16 AND r.relation_type IN('derived-from','quotes','reports','edition-of') AND r.scope_start=-1 AND r.visible_from_generation<=" || generation || " AND (r.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR r.visible_to_generation>" || generation || ")) SELECT json_group_array(DISTINCT family) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN external IS NOT NULL THEN external ELSE coalesce((SELECT nullif(json_extract(description_json,'$.work_ref'),'') FROM source_descriptions d WHERE d.revision_id=u.revision AND d.scope_start=-1 AND d.visible_from_generation<=" || generation || " AND (d.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR d.visible_to_generation>" || generation || ") ORDER BY visible_from_generation DESC LIMIT 1),'revision:'||revision) END family FROM upstream u WHERE external IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_relations r WHERE r.revision_id=u.revision AND r.scope_start=-1 AND r.relation_type IN('derived-from','quotes','reports','edition-of') AND r.visible_from_generation<=" || generation || " AND (r.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR r.visible_to_generation>" || generation || ")) ORDER BY family)"
